sentences.en: A satellite was launched into orbit to monitor melting glaciers.
sentences.zh: 一颗卫星被发射到轨道上以监测冰川融化。

sentences.en: The ocean melted into the sky on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 海平线上的海洋似乎与天边融为一体。

sentences.en: The bus service won't be available until the snow has melted.
sentences.zh: 公交车服务要等到雪化了才会恢复。

senses.zh: 使软化；使融化；使熔化；使感动
